subject: Figurative constant values
notes: Rule: 'The space format represents one or more of the character space in the computer's runtime coded character set.' (cite.py --check 8.3.3.6.4 -> OK 5)). FillChar 'S' -> ' ' for alphanumeric and national; probe probe/figurative-constant-values/p1.cob MOVE SPACE TO PIC X(3), PIC N(3) -> '[   |   ]'; p6.cob INSPECT TALLYING FOR ALL SPACE counts 3 blanks. The boolean arm ('S' against a boolean operand -> '0') is DETERMINATION D-B2 (CONFORMANCE.md), reachable only via §14.9.25.4 GR2's zero-length-literal substitution since MOVE SR7 forbids a written SPACE to a boolean item — a documented latitude choice, not a divergence. No spec-derived test isolates the space character itself; test-needed.
